title: Integration test: full message delivery
description:
What: Integration test: alice sends a message, alice's outbox_worker delivers it to bob over real HTTPS, bob's store contains the message with deliveryState=received.

Algorithm:
1. Use spawn_alice_and_bob() harness from KITH-hvl
2. Build alice's HTTP client: PeerHttpClient::new_with_root_cert(&alice.cert_der) (uses bob's cert too if alice is connecting to bob as owner client)
   Actually: for alice to call Message/set on alice's kithd, use reqwest or hyper client trusting alice's cert.
   For outbox delivery (alice's kithd to bob's kithd), alice's kithd uses the injected PeerHttpClient with bob's cert.
3. Compute chatId = hex(sha256(sorted([uid-alice, uid-bob]).join('\x00'))). Pre-compute offline and hardcode.
4. POST to alice-kithd /jmap/api: Contact/set create bob; Chat/set create chatId; Message/set create {chatId, body='hello'}
5. Start alice's outbox_worker with PeerHttpClient::new_with_root_cert(&bob.cert_der) (this is the key: use bob's self-signed cert)
   outbox_worker(alice.store.clone(), PeerHttpClient::new_with_root_cert(&bob.cert_der), 'uid-alice'.to_string())
   Run as tokio::spawn; wait for delivery event OR poll bob's store
6. Wait (poll every 100ms, timeout 5s): check bob's store for messages with deliveryState=received
7. Assert: bob's store contains message with body='hello', senderId='uid-alice', deliveryState=received
8. Clean up: abort alice/bob handles

Defensive programming:
- Use timeout on wait loop (5s max) to avoid hanging test
- Verify message content against hardcoded expected values (independent oracle: message body is what we sent, not derived from alice's store)
- deliveryState must be 'received' (bob's perspective), not 'delivered' (alice's perspective)
- chatId computed offline (independent of kithd code) and hardcoded as test vector

Agent team: R (read kith-peer delivery path) + I (implement) + T (verify bob has message) + V (cargo test -p kithd)

Tests: bob's message store contains exactly 1 message with body='hello' and deliveryState=Received; alice's outbox row is gone (delivery consumed outbox entry)
